cf_ack_interval.scope: ACK-to-ACK CPU work including intervening tasks; not ISR latency

dtim3_profiler.read_overhead_scope: Read-to-read timer interval; zero is unmeasured; not total instrumentation or silicon WCET

elapsed_timer.scope: Host observation at first visible handler instruction through before executed RTE; excludes unobserved entry instruction and final RTE; includes modeled idle

static_stack_limits: Uses the pinned firmware C ABI: d2..d7/a2..a6 preserved across calls; valid stock tables/indices and seven-stage eDMA protocol. Contract provenance is documented in PRIVATE_STACK_QUALIFICATION.md.
Private boundary excludes original exception frame; nested IRQ costs must be added.
limits: Short rows exercise the stated inputs; they do not establish silicon safety.

Task instructions and UI publication counts do not measure input latency or prove hardware responsiveness.
